title: alint fix report (v1)
description: Output schema emitted by `alint fix --format json`. Locks the public contract for downstream tooling.

schema_version.description: Report schema version. Always 1 for this schema.

dry_run.description: True for `alint fix --dry-run`: nothing was written, and each `applied` item is a fix the first pass would apply. A dry run is a single pass: it predicts a create the real run cannot make stick (an ignored or out-of-scope path, reported `skipped` with `skip_kind: unresolved`), but a fix whose failure only the real run's re-check reveals can still be `applied` here. Always emitted by current alint, but optional in the schema (an additive field within schema_version 1): reports from releases before it was added omit it, which means a real run.

non_convergent.description: True when the fix loop hit its pass cap without converging (exit 2, 'fix could not complete').

skip_kind.description: Present when `status` is `skipped`: why the violation was not fixed. `declined` = the fixer declined (nothing to do, size limit, isolation conflict); `errored` = the fix was attempted and hit an I/O error; `baselined` = grandfathered by `fix --baseline` (benign); `unresolved` = the fix ran (or, under `--dry-run`, would run) but the rule still reports the violation, e.g. a created file the walk ignores or one outside the rule's `paths:`.
